title: Introducing Mantle Equity’s Bulk Draft Data Grid
summary: Closing a round shouldn’t mean filling out the same form 50 times. Bulk Draft Data Grid in Mantle Equity turns your investor list into a spreadsheet-style grid, so you can paste, fill shared terms once, and save everything together.
body_markdown:
Closing a round usually means one investor after another. Open the form, fill it in, save, repeat, until your afternoon is gone. Bulk Draft Data Grid in Mantle Equity turns that into one spreadsheet-style grid, so issuing a round feels like the spreadsheet you already know.


---


### Why founders use a grid


Your investor list already lives in a spreadsheet. Now your round can live in one too. Shared terms like the valuation cap only need to be entered once, and a single typo is easy to spot in a column instead of hiding in one of 50 saved forms. That’s less retyping and more time for the rest of the raise.


---


## How it works


**Paste your list:** Copy your investor list from your own file and paste it into the grid. Each row becomes a draft you can review.


**Copy values down the round:** If a value is the same for everyone, like the valuation gap, drag the fill handle down and it fills the whole round.


**Undo mistakes without worry:** Press Cmd+Z to undo and Cmd+Shift+Z to redo.


**Save everything at once:** When you’re ready, save all 50 with one click.


---


## Which securities does it support?


Bulk Draft Data Grid works for shares, options, warrants, SAFEs, and convertible notes. The feature is also available for managing stakeholders.


---


## Built for founders


The Bulk Draft Data Grid started as a way to turn an afternoon of manual work into a few minutes. Founders use it to get their rounds issued faster, so they can spend that time on the rest of the raise.
